title: RBI Issues Amendment Directions on ‘Matters to be placed before the Boards of the Banks’
description: As announced in the Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies dated April 8, 2026, the Reserve Bank had issued the draft Reserve Bank of India (Governance) Amendment Directions, 2026 on April 8, 2026 for seeking feedback from stakeholders.
